about_the_game:
Brainrot: Story of Glorbo Frutodrillo & Ballerino Cappuccino is a 2D atmospheric visual novel, blending absurdity, paranoia, and mild unease into everyday life.

You play as Glorbofrutodrila — a creature who moves into a new home with his pregnant wife, hoping for peace and a fresh start. But soon, cracks begin to show — both in the walls and in reality. Neighbors whisper, the floor creaks, and one early morning phone call might change everything.

The game features:

  • Branching dialogue and meaningful decisions

  • Memorable characters reacting to your choices

  • Hand-drawn art in a unique visual style

  • Subtle ambient music and immersive sound design

  • A story where nothing is accidental

This is not a horror game. It's a tale of suspicion, strange timing, and the feeling that you're not in full control.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.0 GHz или аналог от AMD
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Любая с поддержкой Shader Model 3.0 (встроенная подойдёт)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 или AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Любая дискретная или современная встроенная
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Life seemed simple... until the cracks appeared. Dive into absurdity, intrigue, and uncanny coincidences in a visual novel where nothing happens by chance.
